summary: ICL Group Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q2 2026 financial results. The filing discloses consolidated sales of $2.1 billion (up 17% year-over-year), operating income of $266 million, adjusted EBITDA of $448 million, and diluted EPS of $0.11. Management also announced a planned organizational realignment into four business segments effective in 2027 and a cost-saving initiative called Elevate targeting over $350 million in savings. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is described; the filing is a routine earnings report. The organizational changes are forward-looking strategic plans, not an event warranting a special-situations category.
